Processes an AudioMoth card from start to end

Source: R/process.R
process_audiomoth.Rd

Chains all the steps:

  1. read_audiomoth(): folder, CONFIG.TXT, location and inventory (and, with copy_to, a copy of the card on the disk, which is used from then on).

  2. prepare_audio(): conversion to 48 kHz mono when needed.

  3. analyze_birdnet(): detections in AudioMoth_<ID>_detections.csv.

  4. export_observation(): AudioMoth_<ID>_observation.csv (only the first time: an existing export, perhaps edited by hand, is kept unless export = TRUE).

  5. extract_examples(): audio, spectrogram and video of the best detections of example_species (when given).

  6. create_validation(): page to validate the records by ear (when validation = TRUE).

  7. create_report(): PDF report (when report = TRUE).

Usage

process_audiomoth(
  folder = choose_folder(),
  coordinates = NULL,
  site = NULL,
  precision_m = NULL,
  time_zone = "Europe/Madrid",
  output = NULL,
  copy_to = NULL,
  example_species = NULL,
  n_examples = 3,
  example_confidence = 0.85,
  video = TRUE,
  video_style = c("cursor", "scroll"),
  export = NULL,
  validation = FALSE,
  report = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

folder

Folder with CONFIG.TXT and the daily folders. By default it is chosen with a dialog (choose_folder()). A copy of the recordings without CONFIG.TXT is also accepted (then coordinates is required).

coordinates

Coordinates of the site in any format accepted by parse_coordinates(). They take priority over those of CONFIG.TXT.

site

Name of the sampling site of this deployment (optional; by default that of the previous deployment when it is in the same place).

precision_m

Precision of the location in metres (the accuracy of Observation.org). By default, the one implied by the number of decimals.

time_zone

Time zone of the local dates and times, as a name of OlsonNames() ("Europe/Madrid", "Atlantic/Canary"...). "UTC+2" is accepted and translated into the fixed zone "Etc/GMT-2".

output

Results folder (it is created if needed). By default it is asked for with choose_output().

copy_to

Copy the card to the disk and work with the copy (see "Copy of the card"): TRUE (into the results folder) or the path of a backup folder. NULL (default): no copy, the card is read where it is.

example_species

Species of which to extract examples: names, a named vector c("Cettia cetti" = 3, ...) with the examples of each one (see detected_species()) or "auto", which takes the species and numbers proposed by detected_species() with example_confidence. NULL (default) = none.

n_examples

Examples per species (one value for all or one per species) when example_species are only names.

example_confidence

Minimum confidence of the examples.

video, video_style

Create the videos of the examples, and their style ("cursor" or "scroll").

export

Export to Observation.org: NULL (default) only when the CSV does not exist yet, TRUE always (an edited CSV is still kept), or FALSE.

validation

Create the validation page (create_validation()).

report

Create a PDF report with create_report() (needs Quarto).

...

Other arguments for analyze_birdnet() (e.g. language, min_confidence, location_threshold, species_list).

Value

Invisibly, the audiomoth object with its detections.

Details

If it is interrupted, running it again continues where it stopped. When output is not given, the results folder is asked for in the console (see choose_output()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Not run: it reads a real card and runs BirdNET, which is installed the
# first time (Python, TensorFlow and the model: about 3 GB)
am <- process_audiomoth(
  coordinates = "41.123456, -3.123456",    # copied from Google Earth
  output = "~/AudiomothR_results/box_01",
  copy_to = TRUE,                          # copy the card first and work on the copy
  example_species = "auto",
  validation = TRUE
)

# With an own list of species instead of the location filter
am <- process_audiomoth(output = "~/AudiomothR_results/box_01", copy_to = "/media/backup",
                        species_list = "~/species_list.txt")
} # }
